heading: Committee Sends Ten-Year Capital Plan to Council
summary: Alders reviewed the 2027–2036 capital improvement plan, including projects that span several years. Members discussed how the Common Council could still amend the plan. The committee voted 8–0 to advance it.

heading: Wisconsin Releases Injury and Violence Prevention Plan
summary: The governor and Department of Health Services released a statewide injury and violence prevention plan. It identifies five priority areas for reducing injuries, violence and violent deaths. The plan is intended to guide work by public health agencies and community partners.
